Description
Completely renovated 3 Bedroom 2 bathroom condo in Yaletown! This property boasts a breathtaking unobstructed view of False Creek, an airy and open living space, with floor-to-ceiling windows that allow you to take in the stunning view. The kitchen is completely renovated with sleek cabinets, modern design & large island making it easy to prepare meals at home. The property is centrally located in the heart of Yaletown and offers top-notch amenities, including indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, gym and courtyard garden. The building is across from the David Lam park, steps away from the Skytrain, Seawall, Roundhouse Community Center, Dining options, shopping, supermarket and all of Yaletown's conveniences. The building also does not allow pets.
